title: mcp-gatehouse audit line
description: One record per tool call, as mcp-gatehouse hands it to the audit sink and as JsonlSink writes it, one JSON object per line. The README's audit section says when each field appears.

ts.description: When the line was written, UTC, ISO-8601 (+00:00).

tier.description: The tool's declared tier. null when the tool wasn't registered through the gate (reason "ungated tool").

outcome.description: ok: the tool ran. denied: the gate refused. error: the tool, the transaction, or item filtering failed. conflict: a conditional write matched nothing. pending: the approval was asked in the client over the 2026-07-28 round trip; the verdict is a later line. cancelled: the client gave up or the server shut down.

reason.description: Why, for every outcome but ok. Denials carry the gate's real reason ("policy: not the owner", "not found: order", "approver refused", "approval timed out", "no verified caller", "ungated tool", "denylist", "missing scope: …"); errors carry the exception type only, never its message; cancellations say the stage ("authorizing", "awaiting approval", "tool running").

arguments.description: The model's arguments after redaction. Values under Policy.redact keys read "«redacted»"; values the redactor can't take apart read "«opaque:TypeName»". Never includes what the gate filled (Load, Scope, Context).

duration_ms.description: How long the tool itself ran, in milliseconds. On ok, conflict, and on error or cancelled lines whose reason says the tool was running.

client_id.description: The OAuth client the token was issued to, or the declared local caller's.

subject.description: The token's sub: the user it acts for. null when the verifier sets none.

issuer.description: The token's iss claim, when the verifier supplies claims.

scopes.description: The scopes the token was granted.

source.description: Present only when the caller is the server's declared local_caller (stdio, in-memory), not a verified token.

caller.description: Who the call was for. Absent on the two denials written before a caller is known: "ungated tool" and "no verified caller".

authz.description: The policy's decision on the call: open for an any_caller tool. Absent on lines written before the policy ran (denylist, no caller, missing scope, loader error, not found, cancelled while loading).

additionalProperties.description: The redacted arguments this record was loaded from, by argument name. Never the record itself.

resources.description: One entry per Load parameter, by parameter name. On every line of a tool that loads records.

items.description: The tool declared authorize_items=any_item: every item is shown to any caller. On every line of such a tool.

consistency.description: How the window between the check and the write is closed. On every line of a tool with consistency= (its own or the Gatehouse default).

consistency_reason.description: The AcceptRace reason. With consistency "accept-race" only.

withheld.description: Items a list tool returned that the caller may not see, so they were removed. On ok lines of tools with authorize_items (other than any_item).

filter_errors.description: How many of the withheld items were withheld because the item policy raised. With withheld, only when above zero.

scope_mismatch.description: A Scope was in force and the gate still had to withhold items: the query and the policy disagree. With withheld, only when true.

sink_error.description: Only on the copy of a line written to stderr instead of the sink: the exception type when the sink raised, "queue full" when a BufferedSink had no room, "sink closed" when a BufferedSink was written to after close. Never in a sink's own output.
